ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) linear and punctate regions. Estimated ratio 75:25 dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity linear pixels (scratches) distributed across both lobes, most concentrated in the upper quadrants. A distinct high-intensity circular blob is located on the mid-left lobe. A vertical high-intensity band is present at the central peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel angle of approximately 50-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3-15 pixels relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper edges of both lobes, tapering to sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity circular clusters detected, notably on the lower left lobe and dispersed along the trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions covering approximately 60% of the visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; prominent vertical white scarring at the base of the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright white vertical pigmentation at the central insertion point where the fluke meets the water line.
